threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered equipment bought from a broker is sold to a DoD or commercial customer
threat_source: Counterfeiters and dishonest brokers in the gray market
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 brokers used without assessment (about 7% of spend); no receiving inspection, seal check, or OEM serial validation; sourcing order not written
affected_asset_or_process: BP-02; BP-04; products delivered to customers
existing_controls: Most purchases from authorized distributors; ERP serial records
treatment_plan: C-SCRM plan with a written sourcing order; authorized sources only for DoD orders from 2026-09-01; broker assessment before any purchase; receiving checklist with OEM serial validation for broker items

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment (FAR 52.204-25) is delivered on a DoD order
threat_source: Data gaps and human error in quoting and purchasing; supplier misrepresentation of the true manufacturer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No screening list; 310 of about 2,300 SKUs have no manufacturer of record; white-label products from brokers
existing_controls: Federal Account Manager checks brand names from memory
treatment_plan: Manufacturer of record required for every SKU; screening list of covered manufacturers and known rebrands; hard block on DoD quotes in the ERP; broker attestation of true manufacturer

threat_event: Supplier email compromise leads to a fraudulent bank-detail change and a diverted supplier payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank-detail changes accepted by email with no call-back; happened in April 2026 ($12,600, recovered)
existing_controls: MFA on the suite; the bank flagged the April 2026 payment
treatment_plan: Call-back on the number already in the ERP for any bank change; Owner approves the first payment to changed details; 5-business-day hold; training on payment fraud

threat_event: The CMMC Level 1 (Self) result and affirmation in SPRS are found unsupported, leading to contract remedies, loss of eligibility, or False Claims Act exposure
threat_source: Gap between what was affirmed and what is in place
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Level 1 MET entered 2026-03-02 with no documented self-assessment; P03 found 11 of 15 FAR requirements not met; no POA&M is allowed at Level 1
treatment_plan: On counsel's advice, correct the SPRS entry; stop accepting new setup orders until a documented self-assessment shows all 15 requirements MET; then enter a supported result and affirmation

threat_event: Phishing takes over a staff mailbox and exposes DoD equipment lists, customer data, and supplier conversations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No training; staff approve MFA prompts without checking; mail on unmanaged personal phones
treatment_plan: MFA number matching; training and phishing simulations; block automatic external forwarding; restrict the Orders folder (R-012)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts laptops, the setup bench, and the synced shared files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Endpoint protection alerts only in business hours; no behavior-based detection; sync carries encrypted files into the suite
treatment_plan: MSP-managed endpoint detection and response with after-hours alerting; immutable backup versions (R-007)

threat_event: Suite mail and files cannot be restored after deletion, corruption, or encryption
threat_source: Backup misconfiguration or deletion with a stolen MSP password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30 days of versions; never restore-tested; backup console login without MFA
treatment_plan: MFA on the backup console; 1-year immutable versions; first restore test 2026-09-30, then quarterly

threat_event: Shared supplier portal or carrier logins are used to place, change, or redirect orders
threat_source: Former employee or attacker with the shared password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One distributor login shared by 3 staff, carrier login shared by all, passwords in a spreadsheet in the Orders folder; portal MFA off
treatment_plan: Named portal accounts with MFA; remove the password spreadsheet; carrier sub-accounts

threat_event: A former employee signs in to the ERP, suite, or a supplier portal after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist; former technician's ERP account active from 2025-11 to 2026-07-15
existing_controls: MFA tied to the user's phone; account disabled 2026-07-15
treatment_plan: Last-day checklist covering ERP, suite, portals, carrier, alarm code, and keys; monthly account reconciliation

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's RMM tool gives an attacker administrator access to every computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM agent on all 9 computers; no review of MSP security; MFA on RMM not evidenced
existing_controls: MSP states it uses MFA on its console
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (questionnaire, MFA evidence, technician list); incident notice within 24 hours and a recovery commitment in the contract at renewal

threat_event: Malware or a tampered image on the setup bench is loaded onto customer devices, including DoD laptops
threat_source: Cybercriminal or tampered device from a supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared administrator account; unrestricted USB; unencrypted; customer devices connect to the staff network
treatment_plan: Separate bench network segment; named accounts; encryption; USB limited to company media; firmware and image hash check before each job

threat_event: DoD equipment lists (FCI) are disclosed from the open Orders folder or local copies
threat_source: Insider error or an attacker using any staff account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Orders folder open to all 7 staff; copies in laptop download folders and on the bench
treatment_plan: Restricted FCI folder for 4 named staff; no local copies except the active bench job, deleted on delivery; personal email rule

threat_event: A lost or stolen laptop exposes customer data or FCI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to customer sites
existing_controls: All 8 laptops encrypted; MSP can wipe remotely
treatment_plan: Accepted: encrypted data is excluded from Florida's personal information definition (501.171(1)(g)2.); residual risk Low

threat_event: Stock or devices are stolen from the stockroom by unescorted visitors or couriers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No escort or visitor log; door propped open during deliveries; alarm code shared and never changed
treatment_plan: Visitor sign-in and escort rule; door closed between deliveries; new alarm codes per person; key log

threat_event: An ERP outage longer than one business day stops quoting, ordering, and invoicing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for orders, inventory, and accounting
existing_controls: Vendor 99.9% availability; RTO 4 h and RPO 1 h in the SOC 2 report
treatment_plan: Downtime steps in the contingency plan: distributor portals and a spreadsheet order log

threat_event: An internet outage stops office access to every SaaS system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Staff can work from home on laptops; phone hotspots
treatment_plan: Accepted: laptops and SaaS allow work from home within the 24-hour MTD; residual risk Low

threat_event: A hurricane closes the office and stockroom for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single site; no contingency plan; stock on the floor of the stockroom
existing_controls: SaaS systems reachable from anywhere; laptops encrypted
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: laptops home before landfall, stock raised off the floor, customers told of delays, distributors drop-ship directly

threat_event: Loss of the Owner or Operations Manager leaves nobody who knows the federal duties, MSP access, or bank processes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two people hold all federal, security, and payment knowledge; no written procedures
existing_controls: The Owner and Operations Manager cover each other informally
treatment_plan: Write the federal order checklist and the incident binder; Federal Account Manager trained as second person for SAM, SPRS, and DIBNet steps

threat_event: A required report is missed: the 1-business-day Section 889 report or the DFARS 252.246-7008 notice to the contracting officer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan before 2026-08; staff unaware of the clocks; no DIBNet account
treatment_plan: POL-03 and P08 runbook; DIBNet account for the Owner and Federal Account Manager; printed contracting officer contacts; tabletop exercise

threat_event: The AI reorder feature auto-submits wrong or excessive purchase orders
threat_source: Model error or bad input data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-submit on for accessory orders under $500 with no human review; forecasts never checked
existing_controls: Distributor order confirmations reviewed by the buyer the next day
treatment_plan: Turn off auto-submit; buyer approves every suggested order; monthly accuracy check (P10)

threat_event: The ERP's AI subprocessor stores or reuses order history, including DoD orders (FCI), outside the company's control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subprocessor terms never reviewed; DoD order lines in the forecasting feed
existing_controls: ERP vendor SOC 2 report lists the subprocessor
treatment_plan: Exclude DoD orders from the forecasting feed; obtain written no-training and deletion terms from the ERP vendor (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste equipment lists, pricing, or customer data into public AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No AI rule before 2026-09; free chatbots used to draft quote descriptions
treatment_plan: POL-04 AI tool rule; one approved business AI assistant for non-FCI drafting; training

threat_event: An outage or credit hold at the main national distributor stops most purchasing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 78% of purchase spend through two distributors, most through one
treatment_plan: Keep current pricing and credit lines with the second distributor; quarterly test order

threat_event: The company itself uses covered video surveillance equipment, so its FAR 52.204-26 "does not use" representation in SAM may be inaccurate
threat_source: Supplier misrepresentation (white-label unit bought from a broker in 2019)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Camera recorder and cameras were never inventoried or screened (found in P07 testing, 2026-08-11)
treatment_plan: Counsel reviews the representation and whether any report is due; screen all company-owned equipment; update SAM if counsel advises

threat_event: An unpatched firewall or other known vulnerability is exploited from the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firewall firmware last updated in 2024; no vulnerability scanning
treatment_plan: Firmware update; quarterly external scan and monthly device scan by the MSP
